capabilities_done: slice 1 (59b6900): pigment LayerExtension.keys (Vec<KeyStage>, serde-skipped when empty, digests unchanged), KeyKind + KeyStage::kind, ExtOperator::Key(KeyKind) (Approximate), PlanError::KeyParameter (out of range, > MAX_KEY_STAGES, difference matte: no clean-plate input in the envelope) / KeyCombination (adjustment, effects, transform, blur, filters, content-aware fill, pass-through, clip roles, extended-range output). render-cpu keys a keyed layer's content (no mask, content bounds inside the plan extent) once with pigment run_key_pipeline before the first chunk (extra Filled node), then composites normally; nested keys -> key_nested; planes + pigment predicted bytes charged before the first sink call; Key(_) declared at pigment's class. render-gpu: every Key kind declared Unsupported -> typed refusal under the stage key before any device work (no WGSL keyer).

slice 2 (81b32be): pigment Projective2 (then, apply, adjugate inverse, from_quads) and LayerTransform.perspective (map = perspective after affine; serde-skipped when None): validation = finite, homogeneous weight > MIN_PERSPECTIVE_WEIGHT at the footprint corners and centre, local Jacobian and inverse within MAX_TRANSFORM_LINEAR, mapped corners within MAX_TRANSFORM_TRANSLATE; destination centres map back through the inverse 3x3, beyond the horizon = transparent; rules 1-5 unchanged. render-cpu and render-gpu take sample sites from PreparedTransform, so both run perspective with no renderer code change. folio StudioCompositionLayer.corner_pin (serde default; records without it byte-identical) = StudioCornerPin {from quad, 8-component keyed to-quad}, convexity + keyframe validation. composite track_apply: corner_frames_from_tracks / corner_frames_from_planar, apply_corner_pin (linear keys, new record), corner_pin_transform (projective LayerTransform), corner_pin_quad_at (motion feature); composition adapter refuses a corner pin typed (composition_corner_pin) instead of dropping it.

slice 3 (9590d37): pigment keyers colour key, colour-difference key, linear colour key (rgb/hue/chroma, keep/remove), extract (channel range, soft ends, invert), inner/outer key (two even-odd paths, colour-line projection in the band), key cleaner (band-limited guided smoothing + alpha contrast), wire removal (segment band from both sides, slope), unmult; KeyKind keys, validation, cost admission; carried by the envelope and render-cpu unchanged. composite tracker: TrackerSession + TrackerCommand: the 18 recovered MotionTracker commands (MoveTrackPoint with/without attach point x 4 directions x 1/10 screen px at the session zoom = 16; SetPointsBarIn/Out = 2) plus AddPoint, RemovePoint, SetCurrentFrame, SetZoom, PlacePoint (manual correction), Analyze forward/backward over the bar (pigment tracker, cancellable, determinate progress); a refused command changes nothing; motion_track -> track_apply.
